items.source_title: Teachers’ Perceptions of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Early Childhood and Primary Education: Barriers, Ethical Concerns, and Perceived Impacts
items.original_excerpt: An interpretive qualitative design was adopted using an open-ended questionnaire completed by 183 teachers from 15 Spanish autonomous communities.
items.claim_text: 西班牙183名幼教與國小教師的開放式問卷質性研究探討生成式AI融入教學時的培訓障礙、倫理與感知影響；屬教師觀點研究，不能推論學生學習成效已被因果驗證。
items.scope_limitation: 10月7日已發表，較本期起始日早2天，僅作延伸閱讀；非10/9–10/15新刊文獻。便利抽樣、教師感受與實際學生能力不同，全文方法與編碼品質仍需按重要性核對。
items.screening_note: High K–12 relevance; publisher-indexed abstract confirms 183 teachers across 15 Spanish regions and qualitative open-ended questionnaire, original date October 7. Background carry-over only. No student learning causal effect.
